name: add_cpp_ring_buffer_overwrite_oldest
description: Change a full-buffer-throws RingBuffer to sliding-window overwrite-oldest semantics; broken overwrites the oldest slot but forgets to advance head, breaking ordering across multiple wraparounds
prompts: RingBuffer::push in ring_buffer.h throws std::overflow_error once the buffer reaches capacity. Change it to sliding-window behavior instead: once full, push(value) overwrites the OLDEST element and the buffer keeps exactly the `capacity` most recent values (no more throwing on a full buffer). at(0) must always be the current oldest element and at(size()-1) the newest, correctly maintained across MANY pushes past capacity (not just one wraparound) - e.g. pushing 1..7 into a capacity-2 buffer must leave exactly [6, 7]. size() never exceeds capacity. at() still throws std::out_of_range for an index outside [0, size()).
